digest.component_or_area: Rebar LLM structured output adapter (Pydantic AI integration)
propositions: Create a new Pydantic output-policy adapter (pai_output.py) that wraps structured.parse_structured and structured.check_response without introducing a new retry loop or provider selection logic
The adapter exposes a TextOutputFunc that runs deterministic tolerant-parse and raises Pydantic ModelRetry on retryable StructuredOutputError, preserving the original Rebar error in __cause__

Implement an after_model_request capability hook that calls structured.check_response to guard against refusal/content-filter responses, raising terminal UnretryableOutputError that aborts after one model call without Pydantic retry prompts
The adapter preserves historical repair, sentinel extraction, and decoy selection behavior byte-for-byte; structured.py remains the pure parser authority with no retry integration added

Integration tests verify that valid responses return typed objects, repairable cases produce identical results before/after adaptation, retryable failures preserve exact StructuredOutputError in ModelRetry cause chain, and refusal responses trigger one-call terminal failures
